messages:
kai: Quick idea: tighten postmortem follow-ups. Proposal: enforce single owner + due_epoch, 30/60/90 checkpoint reminders, and a weekly 3-line digest to #incidents. Add a "remediation" tag so it's filterable. Thoughts?

neha: +1. Ownership drift is real. Suggest mandatory fields: owner, due_epoch, severity, recurrence_tag, blocked_by(opt). If unassigned after 48h auto-assign to oncall lead.

tyler: agree. For checkpoints, auto-create a short comment at 30/60/90 with a snapshot: status & last_update. Keeps history without extra manual work.

kai: automation: 7d & 1d reminders to owner; shepherd nudge if no update 48h after assignment; weekly digest Mon 09:00 with top overdue, recurring patterns, closed this week.

sre-bot: Registered automation draft: rem-2026-19 (reminders + shepherd_nudge + weekly_digest). Opt-in rollout.

neha: recurrence_score idea: count similar incidents in last_90d. Surface >1 as a flag. Also add fields first_seen_epoch, last_seen_epoch for metrics.

tyler: UI: show recurrence badge and allow filter: type=remediation & recurrence_score>1 & open>21d. Also include blocked_eta text field for vendor/legal blockers.

kai: rotation: IC weekly, remediation-shepherd 2-week with 48h shadowing for incoming IC. Shepherd is responsible for nudges and escalations. I'll draft handbook blurb.

neha: pilot? recommend 6-week pilot on auth+kv services. We'll backfill current remediations and measure: avg_time_open, percent_closed_by_due, recurrence_trend.

tyler: I'll own dashboard queries and the recurrence_score calc. kai can own handbook update and digest copy. Neha will run pilot and post weekly updates here.

kai: action summary: neha pilot owner; tyler dashboard + alerts; kai handbook + digest. Reconvene in one week. :calendar:
